title: Integrate Sovereign Studio Architect Tool
body:
This PR integrates the Sovereign Studio v2.0 Architect tool into the Gemini UI application.

Key features included:
- **Architect Blueprint Workflow**: Automated code generation based on high-level technical specifications.
- **GitOps Integration**: Atomic multi-file pushes directly to GitHub via the REST API.
- **AI Utility Toolset**: 20+ specialized AI actions including Security Audits, Big-O analysis, Mermaid diagram generation, and more.
- **Voice Explain**: Text-to-Speech explanation of code using Gemini's TTS model.
- **Responsive Design**: Support for desktop and mobile layouts.

Security and Stability:
- Sanitized user input in chat logs to prevent XSS.
- Verified with full project build and linting.
